inlines.text: Pictures of a vehicle seen from the front through the windshield, plus motorcycle crops for mirrors. Five classes cover four checks: is the window clear or tinted, is a seatbelt on, is a phone in hand, and how many side mirrors does a motorcycle have.

A side mirror seen on a motorcycle.

A Philippine street camera (jeepneys and tricycles are visible): about 3,100 small motorcycle crops with side-mirror boxes. The only side-mirror data we have. Training only; each crop is only about 40 x 90 pixels.

Enforcement-camera views through the windshield (Arabic plates): windshield, seatbelt, phone. The same cars repeat across train, validation and test (video frames and augmented copies), which the cleaning step reduced.

General car-sale photos with a box on every tinted window; many pictures are taken from INSIDE the car and the set has no clear windows. Training only: the tint gate must be tested on Zamboanga footage before it is trusted.

blocks.kicker: Helper collection · teaches the picture enhancer

inlines.text: Clear plate crops, cut from the labelled pictures of the plate set. A
model learns to rebuild a clear plate from a blurry one, so it needs

plates to learn from; the trainer makes the blurry copies itself. A crop is kept only if it is big enough, plate-shaped, sharp and not a repeat, and it inherits the split of its picture so the enhancer is never scored on a plate it saw in training.
Plates on CCTV are small and blurry, and the reader fails on blur. The enhancer is the experiment that tries to help; it is listed in the Training Studio but its training is unproven (the custom
was never shown to beat the ready-made

FIRST DATA FOUND 2026-10-25: mc_helmet_overload (a Philippine street camera, about 3,100 small motorcycle crops, train only, merged under cabin_specialist). Pictures are 640x360, so each crop is only about 40 x 90 px: harvest crops from our own footage (harvest tool) to get a sharp validation set. Other Roboflow projects (mximos-workspace/side-mirror, mohammed-hoodh-valiyaveedu-paramba-ghqjk/side-mirror-bounding-box) were never checked for motorcycles.

slzz-hwlpm/car-window-tint-jw8l0 (4,589 imgs, Public Domain, segmentation, class 'window'): check what 'window' means before mapping to tinted_window. A clear-window set from the same kind of pictures is what tint_windows lacks.

colorumscan/philiipine_license_plate-t1lqw (480 imgs, CC BY 4.0) has classes '0' and 'n': look at them before mapping to license_plate. (colorum_plates, from the same workspace, turned out to be Indian / UK / US plates, so check by eye first.)

Dashcam clips of riders with helmet / no-helmet / plate / triple riding (arXiv 2503.00428, IIIT Hyderabad). The page says 'Coming Soon': nothing to download yet. Watch https://dash-cop.github.io/ or ask the authors.

Excluded on purpose: DeBoniz/helmet-detection-dataset (18k images, origin not stated), dataph Cebu CCTV (30 GB, no licence, shows people), mabo7237/license-plates-700k and sonnetechnology OCR (labels made by a model), seatbelt sets on Hugging Face (whole-photo classification, no boxes), Medellin motorcyclists (riders are not labelled as persons).

tokens.text: # Input: Cropped motorcycle box joined with its riders' person boxes (as engine/pipeline.py crops it,
#        so heads are not cut off). Harvest training crops the same way.
# Task: Detect whether each rider has a valid helmet on their head
# Use composite classes — annotate the WHOLE RIDER, not just the helmet.
# This prevents the "helmet on lap" false negative described in AI_ENGINEERING_PLAN.md.
# The rider's bounding box should span their full torso + head.
# Helmet center is in the top 20% of this box
# No helmet, or helmet held in hand/on lap
